name: Nicereply
description_en:
Nicereply collects customer feedback around support and customer interactions using CSAT, CES and NPS surveys. Distribution options include an email signature, an automatic post-resolution message, a website pop-up or a survey link. Its focus is recurring interaction feedback, rather than general respondent recruitment or a complete research panel.

A help-desk integration can connect ratings with the original ticket and agent context. That context is useful for follow-up but also means a feedback form is not automatically anonymous. Select the measurement and delivery moment before comparing agents or score trends.
description_zh:
Nicereply 围绕支持及客户交互收集 CSAT、CES 和 NPS 反馈，分发方式包括邮件签名、自动解决后邮件、网站弹窗和问卷链接。它主要处理持续交互反馈，而不是一般受访者招募或完整研究样本库。

帮助台集成可把评分连接到原工单和客服背景，有利跟进，也意味着反馈表不自动匿名。比较客服或分数趋势前，应先选定指标和发送时点。

core_features.explanation_en: Combines signature, post-resolution, website pop-up and link surveys.
core_features.explanation_zh: 组合签名、解决后邮件、网站弹窗和链接问卷。

core_features.explanation_en: Help Scout documentation describes ratings/comments as notes, fields and tags with ticket backlinks.
core_features.explanation_zh: Help Scout 文档描述将评分／评论写为备注、字段及标签，并保留工单链接。

core_features.explanation_en: Pricing counts received survey responses rather than sent invitations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 定价计收到的回答，而不是发出的邀请。

steps.en: Choose the retained plan, authorize the help-desk integration and decide whether ratings should become ticket notes, custom fields or tags. The guide says customer names can be synchronized using ticket IDs and imported agents receive login instructions. Those are consequential actions to review before bulk user import. The guide is dated January 2023, so its exact present-day UI path needs an account check. This is hosted software; no self-hosted package or source-code license was verified.
steps.zh: 选择长期套餐、授权帮助台集成，并决定评分是否写入工单备注、自定义字段或标签。指南说明可依据工单 ID 同步客户姓名，导入客服会收到登录说明；批量导入前需审核这些实际动作。指南日期为 2023 年 1 月，当前界面具体路径仍需账户检查。产品是托管软件，未核实自托管包或源代码许可。

items.en: Nicereply may fit support teams needing a low-friction rating and a route back to the case. A long market-research questionnaire addresses a different task. Do not interpret low-response agent rankings as equivalent workloads or assume every unsatisfied customer answers. Periodic scanning is not an instantaneous delivery guarantee. Duplicate invitations, reopened tickets, over-cap treatment and failed note writes need testing. The documented lack of default feedback deletion does not establish every contractual retention right.
items.zh: 需要简短评分和返回原案例路径的支持团队可评估 Nicereply；长市场研究问卷是不同任务。不要把少量回答的客服排名视为相同工作负荷，也不能假定所有不满客户都会回答。定期扫描不是即时投递保证。重复邀请、重开工单、超额处理和备注写入失败需测试。文档称默认不删除反馈，但这不能建立全部合同保留权利。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starter is $79/month billed monthly or $59/month billed annually, for 100 monthly responses and three users. Essential is $149/$119 for 250 responses and ten users; Growth $299/$239 for 1,000 and twenty-five; Business $449/$359 for 2,500 and fifty. All list unlimited active surveys. A fourteen-day all-feature trial requires no card; the thirty-day money-back guarantee is separate. Without purchase the trial account expires. Larger capacity needs a quote; no permanent free plan was established.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Starter 月付每月 79 美元或年付每月等值 59 美元，含每月 100 回答与三人。Essential 为 149／119 美元、250 回答与十人；Growth 为 299／239 美元、1,000 回答与二十五人；Business 为 449／359 美元、2,500 回答与五十人。均列无限活动问卷。十四天全功能试用免信用卡，三十天退款保证另算。不购买则试用账户到期，更多容量需询价，未建立永久免费档。

sections.title_zh: 选择对话中或解决后反馈
sections.en: The Help Scout guide first asks users to select CSAT, CES or NPS, then choose a signature template or a trigger and connect accounts. A signature lets the customer rate each interaction; a trigger scans ticket status periodically and sends after resolution with an adjustable delay. For a proposed pilot, close one known test ticket, inspect the survey and verify that the resulting note links to the correct ticket. No account was connected or message sent for this research.
sections.zh: Help Scout 指南先要求选择 CSAT、CES 或 NPS，再选择签名模板或触发器并连接账户。签名让客户评价每次交互，触发器则定期扫描工单状态，在解决后按可调整延迟发送。试点可关闭一个已知测试工单，检查问卷并确认结果备注关联正确工单。本研究未连接账户或发送消息。
